branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A soft, creamy cow's-milk cheese with a white, velvety bloomy rind, made with salt, rennet, lactic cultures and Penicillium candidum. It is made by the Centro Veneto Formaggi at Cavaso del Tomba, in the Pedemontana del Grappa.

sources.text: The ingredients, the rind and the producer.
